issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Two small computations, written up as a one-page report.

1. Fit a straight line to 40 noisy points: x = 0, 1, ..., 39 and y = 2.5 + 0.8 x + e, where e is drawn from a normal distribution with standard deviation 3 using numpy.random.default_rng(227). Report the slope and the intercept with 95% confidence intervals, and one figure of the data with the fitted line.

2. Run `simulate.py` from the initial state once in full (`python3 -u simulate.py --out results.json`, 90 chunks). It estimates pi by Monte Carlo and takes 15 to 20 minutes on one CPU. Report its estimate with the 95% interval it prints, and whether the interval contains pi.

Deliver `report/report.md` (Markdown is enough) with both results and the figure, and the code that produced every number next to it.
